reviewNotes: HOLD — UGANC is a public university under the higher-education ministry, its official site identifies the Faculté des sciences et techniques de la santé, and a current ministry item identifies the Faculty of Medicine. The available official admissions page identifies an online process and the homepage reports a first-year registration fee of 300,000 GNF, but these do not establish a current medicine award, duration, language, medicine-specific tuition, international eligibility, intake, clinical route, accommodation or recognition. No fee was extrapolated from unrelated postgraduate records.
